=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py | lines 2523-2524 (in `latest_trusted_autofix_marker_is_host_only`); comparison to `count_identical_failures` lines 2769-2770
  PROBLEM: The substring match `PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE_COMMENT_MARKER in body` on line 2523 can trigger on a markerless failure comment whose log-derived "First error" or log tail happens to contain the literal string "AI review/autofix paused — model provider unavailable". When it fires, the comment is `continue`-skipped instead of falling through to the `AUTOFIX_FAILURE_COMMENT_MARKERS` check on line 2529 that would `return False`. An older host-only marker then decides for the newer, unrelated failure, and the label reporter suppresses the heal.
  WHY: A genuine autofix failure whose captured log tail echoes the pause string would be silently treated as an outage pause by the substring check; the older host-only stop would suppress its heal report.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py | location: lines 2485-2497 (function docstring for `latest_trusted_autofix_marker_is_host_only`)
  PROBLEM: The docstring states "the first trusted ``review-autofix-failure:v1`` or ``review-autofix-failure-cap:v1`` marker decides" but a trusted marker whose `reason` is `provider_unavailable` is now skipped and the scan continues past it; markerless bodies containing `PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE_COMMENT_MARKER` are also skipped.
  WHY: The function-level contract omits this behavior, which can mislead future readers.
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
